d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

We are looking for a Head Chef to lead our Central Kitchen team in Bahrain. The role will oversee daily kitchen operations, high-volume food production, and team management, ensuring consistent food quality, operational efficiency, and adherence to food safety standards.
q: 8+ years of culinary experience, with proven experience as a Head Chef or a strong Senior Sous Chef ready to step up.
Experience in central kitchens, cloud kitchens, catering, food production, or other high-volume environments.
Strong experience in batch cooking and large-scale food production.
Proven ability to lead, train, and manage kitchen teams.
Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards.
Experience with inventory management, food costing, portion control, and waste reduction.
Currently based in Bahrain or willing to relocate.
Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
Detail-oriented, with a strong focus on consistency and efficiency.
Able to make sound decisions and manage operational challenges.
Passionate about food quality, team development, and operational excellence.
